Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly requested disambiguation and verification of sources, WebSurfer repeatedly ran the same search and failed to open and extract information from the cited pages (e.g., Discogs, Metal Archives, Wikipedia). This looping behavior ignored instructions to verify origins and list candidates, failed to resolve the Discogs snippet ambiguity (“Country: US”), and prevented reaching the correct conclusion (that Dark at Dawn is German while The Catheters are American).
